gen-vast-shadow-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Retro and hard to ignore, Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single width, so its bowls carry full stem weight. And Atkinson Hyperlegible, friendly beside all that loudness, has clipped capitals and wide-set s terminals.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru keeps its lowercase tall, nearly touching ascender height. Vast Shadow is the one to catch attention, with vintage swagger and generous space around each letter, while Hind Mysuru does the steady work of staying readable.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Every stroke of Vast Shadow is cut to a single width, giving it vintage, eye-catching presence on its own. Noto Sans Armenian then reads smoothly, its round letters wide and inviting.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Vast Shadow draws each letter like a length of pipe, every stroke uniform in width, with vintage drama to spare. Noto Sans Balinese keeps short ascenders and breathing room inside its curves.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Vast Shadow traces every letter at the width of one stylus, giving it a vintage, eye-catching look. And Noto Sans Chorasmian is the quiet strength, with curves that stop short of closing and a large x-height.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-hk: Bent like a single length of tubing, Vast Shadow is all vintage showmanship. Noto Sans HK handles the quiet work, with large lowercase forms and brush ends that lift away before each curve closes.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Glass tubing, bent into letters: Vast Shadow looks vintage and loud, every stroke cut to one width. Noto Sans Khojki gives it room to breathe, with wide exits and a large eye on every e.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Traced with one marker, Vast Shadow is vintage and hard to look past. Noto Sans Limbu then settles into text smoothly, its gaping curves and tall-bodied small letters keeping a page approachable.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Vintage and loud, Vast Shadow looks sketched by a pencil that never presses harder, with generous space around each letter. Noto Sans Malayalam softens the shout with a dominant middle zone.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numer: Vast Shadow runs a pen-like line of constant weight, vintage and eye-catching from the first letter. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals supplies the hook: tall-bodied small letters and a gaping c at any size.
